item.title: Fans Choose Ha*Ash’s ‘¿Qué Le Pongo?’ as Best New Latin Music of the Week
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update! We're diving into the latest from Billboard's New Music Latin poll. And the winner is... Ha*Ash with their new song '¿Qué Le Pongo?'!"
[Short music clip of "¿Qué Le Pongo?" plays]
Host: "This Mexican duo took the top spot with over 61% of the vote, beating out other popular releases from Feid, De La Rose, and more. So, what's the song about? '¿Qué Le Pongo?' is a heartfelt, country-tinged pop ballad about someone who's trying to decide whether to reply to a text from an ex-partner."
[Short music clip of "¿Qué Le Pongo?" plays again]
Host: "The song's lyrics are relatable and contemporary, with lines like 'What should I reply so they won't think I still miss them?' The music video is also worth checking out, featuring the two sisters driving a vintage pickup truck."
[Short music clip of other songs plays]
Host: "Other fan favorites in this week's poll include La Cassandra and Martox's 'Paraíso', Feid's 'A Xon de Que', and Edgardo Nuñez's 'Bendecido'. You can check out the full poll results on Billboard's website."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this week's music update! If you want to stay up-to-date on the latest music trends, be sure to follow us for more updates and behind-the-scenes insights."
